name: Cube.js
description_en:
Cube.js is a product in the IDEs category. Its directory profile covers Code Completion, Real-time Collaboration, Debugger, Source code editor, Chat (Messaging), Version Control.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are All (Small, Medium, Large) Freelancers. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Starts at $99.00. Offers Free-forever and Custom plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: suggest code while it is being written; exchange messages within the supported workspace; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为小型、中型与大型组织 自由职业者。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

第三方定价快照显示：未提供免费试用 起价为 $99.00. 另有持续免费方案和定制方案。。这属于采集时的第三方参考，实际金额、计费周期、试用条件及地区可用性仍需核对官网。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在编写过程中提供代码补全建议；在受支持的工作空间中交换消息；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
